goal: Tool lines in the session transcript become scannable: each TOOL_CALL shows the tool's most informative argument and each TOOL_RESULT renders as an indented outcome line that stays brief on success and shows red, capped multi-line detail on error.

references: Spec FR-2: per-tool key-argument map, e.g. file_path for Edit/Read/Write, command for Bash, pattern for Grep/Glob; unmapped tools keep the existing first-two-keys k=v form
Spec FR-3: success renders one indented line like 'ok' plus a brief content hint (first line or line count); is_error results render up to 10 lines with an '... +N more lines' suffix beyond
constraints: Do not pair tool_use ids with results; call and result remain separate entries and a result without a visible preceding call must still render standalone
Error tool results use an error/red style and are never dimmed

Tests pinning the old tool-line shapes must be updated in the same commit: packages/flywheel/tests/test_session.py::test_classify_assistant_tool_use_collapses_args, test_classify_user_tool_result_collapses_size_and_body, test_classify_user_tool_result_flags_error, and packages/flywheel/tests/test_session_screen.py::test_session_screen_renders_all_message_classes

Add test coverage for the FR-2/FR-3 acceptance: Edit shows its file_path, Bash shows its command, an unmapped tool keeps k=v form, a successful result is one brief line, and a 30-line error shows 10 lines plus a '+20 more lines' marker
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: No suppression of successful results; every result still renders
No lifecycle, timestamp, spacing, or style-map work beyond the error-result style (later tasks in this phase)
edge_cases: Tool input that is not a mapping, or a mapped tool missing its key argument: fall back to the existing summary form, never raise
Very long single-line commands wrap at widget width rather than truncating
Multiple consecutive tool_use blocks in one AssistantMessage keep record order
